# Pagination

**Figma:** Pagination + .Primitives/Pagination/Item (page 774:15997)  
**Import:** `import { Pagination } from "@zen-ds/react";`

Move through a large, ordered result set one page at a time.

## Use it for
- Tables and result lists where position matters ("page 3 of 10").
- Inline/Manually themes for data tables with a page-size choice or a jump-to-page field.

## Use something else for
- Short lists that fit on one screen; show everything.
- Continuous feeds → load more / infinite scroll.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Theme | `theme` | primary · secondary (numbered) · inline (page size + range) · manually (jump field + range) |
| Size | `size` | sets both the page items and the ‹ › arrows: xsmall = 24 (Icon-Main XSmall, Figma) · small = 32 (Icon-Main Small) |
| Pages | `page / onPageChange / pageCount` | ellipsis collapses the middle |
| Range | `pageSize / total / pageSizeOptions / onPageSizeChange` | “1–50 of 100 results” |

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/pagination.json`.

### Pagination
Figma Pagination (774:29083). Button/Icon-Main XSmall Tertiary ‹ › (icon-chevron-*-line-small) around the content, Spacing/Gap/Medium between groups; Pages gap Spacing/Gap/2XSmall; Inline/Manually navigator gap XSmall. The arrows follow `size` (Figma draws XSmall only): XSmall items (24, Select-Item/Size/Small) keep Icon-Main XSmall (Button/Size/XSmall), Small items (32, Select-Item/Size/Medium) take Icon-Main Small (Button/Size/Small), so the arrows always match the items in both densities.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` (required) | `number` | — | 1-based current page. |
| `onValueChange` | `(page: number) => void` | — | Called with the new 1-based page when ‹ › or a page item is pressed. |
| `onPageChange` | `(page: number) => void` | — | Called with the new page number (1-based). `onValueChange` is the same callback under the name value controls share. |
| `theme` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "inline" \| "manually"` | `"primary"` | Primary/Secondary: numbered items. Inline: page-size Chip + range label. Manually: page-size Input + range label. |
| `pageCount` | `number` | — | Number of pages (Primary/Secondary). For Inline/Manually it is derived from `total` / `pageSize`. |
| `pageSize` | `number` | `50` | Items per page and total items (Inline/Manually). |
| `total` | `number` | `0` |  |
| `pageSizeOptions` | `number[]` | `[10, 25, 50, 100]` |  |
| `onPageSizeChange` | `(pageSize: number) => void` | — |  |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "xsmall" \| "small"` | `"xs"` | Page items and the ‹ › arrows: xs = 24px (Figma) · sm = 32px. Short (xs, sm) or Figma (xsmall, small) spelling. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | — | Accessible name of the navigation landmark. Default: the locale's “Pagination”. |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

### PaginationItem
Figma .Primitives/Pagination/Item (774:15999). The ellipsis renders as a non-interactive item.

Also accepts `Omit<ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, "children">`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` (required) | `number \| "…"` | — |  |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "xsmall" \| "small"` | `"xs"` | Figma Size: XSmall 24 (Select-Item/Size/Small) · Small 32 (Select-Item/Size/Medium). Short (sm, md…) or Figma (small, medium…) spelling. |
| `level` | `"primary" \| "secondary"` | `"primary"` | Selected fill: Primary Active/Neutral/Solid (Inverse label) · Secondary Active/Neutral/Subtle. |
| `selected` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `optional` | `boolean` | `false` | Narrow screens hide optional pages (everything but first, last and current), keeping `1 … 5 … 12`. |

## Keyboard
| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Move between pages and arrows |
| Enter / Space | Go to the page |
| Enter (page field) | Jump to the typed page (Manually) |

## ✅ Do
- Keep the current page visible and marked (aria-current).
- Show first and last pages with an ellipsis for long ranges.
- In tables, pick the page size with the Inline theme's Chip.
- Scroll back to the top of the list after a page change.

## ❌ Don't
- Don't paginate lists with only one or two pages.
- Don't reset filters or sorting when the page changes.
- Don't use numbered pages for unbounded feeds.
- Don't paginate fewer than 3 pages (harness: pagination/worth-paging).

## Accessibility
- nav with aria-label; the current page has aria-current=page; prev/next are labelled IconButtons that disable at the ends.
- The range text updates in an aria-live region.
- Under 480px long ranges drop the optional page numbers and keep first · current · last with ellipses; the bar wraps instead of overflowing.

## Content
- The Inline/Manually range reads “1–10 of 1,284 results”, with an en dash and the locale's thousands separator (vi “1–10 trên 1.284 kết quả”).

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pagination/worth-paging` | warn | Paginate only when there are 3+ pages; otherwise show everything. | `zen-allow-short-pagination: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
| `interaction/controlled-needs-handler` | warn | A controlled prop comes with its change handler (month + onMonthChange, value + onValueChange, open + onOpenChange, pageSize + onPageSizeChange…): without it nothing can change the value and the control is frozen, e.g. a DatePicker whose Previous/Next do nothing. Bare booleans (a fixed preview) and `x ? true : undefined` pins pass. | `zen-allow-controlled-handler: <reason>` |
